# TikTok

34 endpoints, all GET. Base URL `https://www.socialcrawl.dev`, auth header `x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY`.

**Credit costs:** 25 standard (1 credit), 5 advanced (5), 1 premium (10), 3 custom (flat/metered) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

## GET /v1/tiktok/adlibrary/ad - 5 credits (advanced)

Get a TikTok Ad Library ad

**Cost** 5 credits (advanced) · **Cache** 1800s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** Post · **Pagination** none

Returns one ad from the TikTok Ad Library: creative video, title, advertiser TikTok account, landing page, brand name, and first-shown date. Pass ad_id or a library.tiktok.com URL.

**Query params**

- `ad_id` (optional, string) - TikTok Ad Library ad id, or a library.tiktok.com ads/detail URL. · e.g. `1869335220395266`
- `url` (optional, string) - TikTok Ad Library ads/detail URL.

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `ad_id`, `url`.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/tiktok/adlibrary/ad?ad_id=1869335220395266" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/tiktok/adlibrary/search - 5 credits (advanced)

Search the TikTok Ad Library

**Cost** 5 credits (advanced) · **Cache** 120s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** PostList · **Pagination** cursor - `cursor`

Returns ads from the TikTok Ad Library matching a keyword or advertiser name. Each ad includes creative video, title, advertiser name, impression estimate, and first-shown date. Page with cursor.

**Query params**

- `query` (optional, string) - Keyword or phrase to search the TikTok Ad Library.
- `advertiser_name` (optional, string) - Advertiser name as it appears in the TikTok Ad Library. · e.g. `Gymshark`
- `cursor` (optional, string) - Cursor from the previous response to fetch the next page.

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `query`, `advertiser_name`.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/tiktok/adlibrary/search?advertiser_name=Gymshark" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/tiktok/ads/top - 10-100 credits (request-shaped)

Read TikTok's Creative Center Top Ads board: the best-performing ads in a market, ranked by CTR, impressions or engagement. Metered: 1 credit per ad returned, minimum 10

**Cost** 10-100 credits (request-shaped) · **Cache** 1800s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** PostList · **Pagination** single page - The Creative Center board is a ranked leaderboard with no cursor. `limit` controls how far down the ranking you read; change `period`, `country` or the filters for a different board.
**Pricing** 1 credit per ad returned, minimum 10 credits. A limit of 20 holds 20 credits and settles down to the number of ads that actually came back; a filter combination with no board costs nothing. (metered, 10-100 credits; the response `credits_used` is the real charge after refund).

Returns TikTok's own leaderboard of top-performing ads for a market and time window, with the performance signals TikTok publishes and nothing else does: `ext.ad.ctr` is the click-through rate, `ext.ad.rank` is the ad's position on the board, `ext.ad.cost_score` and `ext.ad.like_tier` are TikTok's own banded cost and engagement tiers, and `engagement.likes` is the real like count. Each row carries the ad's video at `content.media_urls` (720p, with 540p and 360p renditions on `ext.ad`), the cover image, the duration, the advertiser at `author.username`, and the campaign objective and industry at `ext.ad.objective` / `ext.ad.industry`. **This is a different surface from `/v1/tiktok/adlibrary/search`.** That endpoint reads the EU Commercial Content Library, which carries who an ad was targeted at across 33 EU/EEA countries but publishes no performance data; this one reads the global Creative Center board across 24 markets including the US, Korea, Japan and Brazil, and publishes performance but no targeting. Use this one to find creative that worked, and that one to find who an advertiser bought. **There is no publish date**: TikTok does not attach one to the board, so `published_at` is null on every row rather than filled with the time you called. `brandName` is absent on roughly half of live rows because TikTok attributes some top ads to no brand, so `author.username` is null there too. **Pricing is metered at 1 credit per ad RETURNED, with a minimum of 10** — the board is served in blocks of ten, so a smaller `limit` still costs ten.

**Query params**

- `country` (optional, enum: US | CA | MX | BR | GB | DE | FR | IT | ES | NL | PL | SE | TR | SA | AE | AU | JP | KR | ID | TH | VN | MY | PH | SG) - Creative Center market to read the board for. Defaults to US. This is the market the ads ran in, not the language they are in. · e.g. `US`
- `period` (optional, enum: 7 | 30 | 180) - Lookback window in days: 7, 30 or 180. Defaults to 30. A longer window is a different board, not more rows. · e.g. `30`
- `order_by` (optional, enum: for_you | impression | ctr | play_2s_rate | play_6s_rate | cvr | like) - How TikTok ranks the board: for_you (TikTok's own blend, the default), ctr, impression, like, cvr, play_2s_rate or play_6s_rate. · e.g. `ctr`
- `ad_format` (optional, enum: All ad types | Spark ads | Non-Spark ads) - Restrict to Spark ads (ads boosted from an organic post) or Non-Spark ads. Defaults to all.
- `ad_language` (optional, enum: en | ja | zh | vi | th | pt | id) - Filter by the language of the ad copy.
- `like_tier` (optional, enum: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5) - TikTok's engagement percentile band, 1 (top) to 5. Use it to read further down the ranking without raising limit.
- `industry` (optional, string) - Creative Center industry category, for example 'Skincare' or 'Financial Services'. Omit for all industries.
- `objective` (optional, string) - Campaign objective, for example campaign_objective_traffic or campaign_objective_conversion.
- `keyword` (optional, string) - Search the board by brand or product keyword.
- `limit` (optional, integer, 1-100) - How many ads to return, 1-100, default 20. The board is served in blocks of ten, so any limit below 10 still costs 10 credits.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/tiktok/ads/top" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```


## GET /v1/tiktok/comment - 2-6 credits (request-shaped)

Look up one TikTok comment by URL or id

**Cost** 2-6 credits (request-shaped) · **Cache** 300s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** Comment · **Pagination** none
**Pricing** 2 credits for a standard lookup, 6 with `deep_scan=true`, which keeps paging the thread when the comment is not in the first pages. Reach for deep_scan only after a standard lookup comes back not-found (metered, 2-6 credits; the response `credits_used` is the real charge after refund).

Resolves a single TikTok comment to a live comment object (current like count, reply count, pinned flag, author, timestamp) without you paginating the comment section. Pass `comment_url` (a `.../@{handle}/video/{id}?comment_id={cid}` link, an `m.tiktok.com` share link, or a `vm.tiktok.com`/`.../t/` shortlink: resolved automatically) OR `post_url` + `comment_id`. For a reply, also pass `parent_comment_id` (a reply URL does not carry its parent). Instead of a comment id you can search the comment section: `author_username` (find a specific author's comments) or `text_contains` (exact snippet) return up to `max` matches. The response includes a `lookup.position_hint`: pass it back on a later lookup of the same comment to make the re-check nearly free. Flat 2 credits (6 with `deep_scan=true`, which widens the scan budget); a not-found returns 404 and is fully refunded.

**Query params**

- `comment_url` (optional, string) - A TikTok comment URL: `https://www.tiktok.com/@{handle}/video/{videoId}?comment_id={cid}`, the `m.tiktok.com/v/{id}.html?...&share_comment_id={cid}` share form, or a `vm.tiktok.com/{code}` / `tiktok.com/t/{code}` shortlink. The `cid`/`comment_id`/`share_comment_id` query value may be numeric or the base64 form TikTok's share sheet emits (`?cid=NzY1...`): both are accepted; base64 is decoded automatically. Mutually exclusive with `post_url`+`comment_id`. · e.g. `https://www.tiktok.com/@mrbeast/video/7654638524729216287?comment_id=7654640784985211670`
- `post_url` (optional, string) - The post URL (`https://www.tiktok.com/@{handle}/video/{videoId}`). Combine with `comment_id`, or with `author_username`/`text_contains` for a search.
- `comment_id` (optional, string) - The target comment's numeric id (the `cid` from the comments endpoint). Requires `post_url`. Note that TikTok share links carry a base64-encoded `cid`: pass such a link as `comment_url` instead (decoded automatically), or base64-decode the value to its digits before passing it here.
- `parent_comment_id` (optional, string) - The parent comment's numeric id: supply this when the target is a reply so it can be resolved directly via the native replies endpoint.
- `author_username` (optional, string) - Return up to `max` comments authored by this username (no comment id needed). Mutually exclusive with `text_contains` and any comment id.
- `text_contains` (optional, string) - Return up to `max` comments whose text contains this snippet (case-insensitive). Mutually exclusive with `author_username` and any comment id.
- `deep_scan` (optional, boolean) - Widen the scan budget for deeply-buried comments (raises the page ceiling and deadline). Bills 6 credits instead of 2.
- `position_hint` (optional, string) - Opaque token from a prior lookup's `lookup.position_hint`. Passing it back probes the comment's last-known location first, making a re-check of an already-found comment cheap.
- `max` (optional, integer) - For `author_username`/`text_contains` search: max matches to return (1-20, default 5).

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `comment_url`, `post_url`.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/tiktok/comment?comment_url=https://www.tiktok.com/@mrbeast/video/7654638524729216287?comment_id=7654640784985211670" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/tiktok/effect/videos - 1 credit (standard)

List TikTok videos made with an effect

**Cost** 1 credit (standard) · **Cache** 600s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** PostList · **Pagination** cursor - `cursor`

Returns public videos created with a TikTok effect, with full engagement counts and author details on every row. TikTok chooses its own page size here and it does not track the number you ask for, so send the `cursor` from the previous response back unchanged rather than adding up the rows you have received. An effect id TikTok does not recognise returns `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` and is refunded.

**Query params**

- `effect_id` (required) - TikTok effect id, as returned by /v1/tiktok/effects. · e.g. `1108584`
- `cursor` (optional, string) - Cursor from the previous response to fetch the next page of videos.
- `region` (optional, string) - Two-letter country code for the proxy location. Defaults to US.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/tiktok/effect/videos?effect_id=1108584" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/tiktok/effects - 1 credit (standard)

Get TikTok effects by id

**Cost** 1 credit (standard) · **Cache** 600s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** PostList · **Pagination** single page - Batch id lookup: the caller supplies the full set of ids and the response carries no cursor, no has_more and no total.

Looks up TikTok effects (the camera filters creators apply to a video) by id, up to 50 in one request for a single credit. Each row carries the effect name, its designer, the total views of videos made with it under `post.engagement.views`, and the number of such videos under `post.ext.video_count`. Match results by the returned `post.id`, never by position: repeated ids are collapsed into one row and ids TikTok does not recognise are omitted, so the response can be shorter than the list you sent. A request in which no id is recognised returns `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` and is refunded.

**Query params**

- `ids` (required) - Comma-separated TikTok effect ids, up to 50 per request. · e.g. `1108584,1109028`

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/tiktok/effects?ids=1108584,1109028" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/tiktok/hashtag - 1 credit (standard)

Get TikTok hashtag details

**Cost** 1 credit (standard) · **Cache** 600s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** Post · **Pagination** none

Returns TikTok's own record for a hashtag: its display name, its description where the platform has written one, and the two numbers that size it. `post.engagement.views` is the total views of videos under the tag and it is live, moving between calls minutes apart. `post.ext.video_count` is how many videos carry the tag. Pass either the tag name or, if you already have it, TikTok's numeric hashtag id. Use `/v1/tiktok/search/hashtag` to read the videos themselves.

**Query params**

- `hashtag` (optional, string) - Hashtag name, with or without the leading # symbol. · e.g. `kpop`
- `hashtag_id` (optional, string) - TikTok numeric hashtag id. Skips the name lookup when you already have it.

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `hashtag`, `hashtag_id`.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/tiktok/hashtag?hashtag=kpop" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/tiktok/playlist/videos - 1 credit (standard)

List videos in a TikTok playlist

**Cost** 1 credit (standard) · **Cache** 600s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** PostList · **Pagination** cursor - `cursor`

Returns the videos inside one of a creator's profile playlists, in playlist order, ten per page. Each video carries the full set of engagement counts, the caption, the author, and a playable URL. Get the `playlist_id` from `/v1/tiktok/profile/playlists`. Page with `cursor`: the value the previous response returned must be sent back unchanged, because it is the upstream's own item index and is not always the number of rows you have already received.

**Query params**

- `playlist_id` (required) - Playlist id from /v1/tiktok/profile/playlists (`post.id` on that response). · e.g. `7229371484127382314`
- `handle` (optional, string) - TikTok username of the playlist owner, without the @ symbol. · e.g. `chipotle`
- `user_id` (optional, string) - TikTok numeric user ID of the playlist owner. Use this for faster responses.
- `cursor` (optional, string) - Cursor from the previous response to fetch the next page of videos.

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `handle`, `user_id`.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/tiktok/playlist/videos?playlist_id=7229371484127382314&handle=chipotle" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/tiktok/post - 1 credit (standard)

Get TikTok post details

**Cost** 1 credit (standard) · **Cache** 600s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** Post · **Pagination** none
**Reliability** Multi-source: a primary provider with an automatic fallback. You are charged once no matter how many sources are tried.

Returns detailed information about a specific TikTok video including view count, like count, comment count, share count, caption, music info, author details, and video metadata. When the creator added on-screen text with TikTok's built-in text tool, the overlay text is returned in `data.post.ext.on_screen_texts` (absent when the video has none: text burned in with an external editor is not detectable from post data).

**Query params**

- `url` (required) - Full URL of the TikTok video · e.g. `https://www.tiktok.com/@charlidamelio/video/7321485815660738859`
- `region` (optional, string) - Two-letter country code for the proxy region (US, GB, FR, PH). The primary source does not take a region, so it is honoured only when a fallback source serves the request; a region-locked video (commonly from the Philippines) that fails on the primary is retried on the fallback with this value.
- `trim` (optional, boolean) - Accepted for compatibility; the response is already the canonical shape, so this flag has no effect.
- `download_media` (optional, boolean) - Set to true to also download the video/images and get back durable hosted media URLs under `data.post.ext.download_media_urls` (`[{ post_id, cdn_url, type, cached }]`). Use these for archiving; the raw `media_urls` are short-lived signed CDN links that expire. Adds a few seconds of latency while the media is fetched. Availability is source-dependent and most responses will not carry it: when the serving source cannot host durable copies the field is absent, the response carries a `data._warnings` note saying so, and `data.post.content.media_urls` still carries the media.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/tiktok/post?url=https://www.tiktok.com/@charlidamelio/video/7321485815660738859" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

Get TikTok video transcript

**Cost** 10 credits (premium) · **Cache** 2592000s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** Transcript · **Pagination** none

Returns the transcript of a TikTok video. Supports auto-generated captions and AI-powered transcription as fallback.

**Query params**

## GET /v1/tiktok/profile - 1 credit (standard)

Get TikTok user profile

**Cost** 1 credit (standard) · **Cache** 900s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** Author · **Pagination** none
**Reliability** Multi-source: a primary provider with an automatic fallback. You are charged once no matter how many sources are tried.

Returns public profile information for a TikTok user: follower count, following count, total likes, bio, avatar URL, and verification status. `author.followers` is the unrounded integer when the source exposes it. When only the public rounded figure is available, the same integer field is returned and `author.ext.followers_approximate` is true. Pass either `handle` or `user_id`. Profiles behind TikTok's 'audience controls' (a login/age wall in the browser) now return their profile record normally; their posts are readable through `/v1/tiktok/profile/videos` with the same handle. A profile with no publicly readable record still returns `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` with `error.details.reason` set to `account_private`. A handle the platform reports as unused returns the same status with `reason` set to `account_gone`; because TikTok numeric ids are permanent, re-running the lookup with `user_id` tells a renamed account from a removed one.

**Query params**

- `handle` (optional, string) - TikTok username without the @ symbol. · e.g. `charlidamelio`
- `user_id` (optional, string) - TikTok numeric user ID. Use this for faster responses.

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `handle`, `user_id`.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/tiktok/profile?handle=charlidamelio" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/tiktok/profile/full - 5 credits (custom)

TikTok profile, recent posts, and computed analytics in one call.

**Cost** 5 credits (custom) · **Cache** 900s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** Analytics · **Pagination** cursor - `cursor`

Fans out to the TikTok profile and recent-posts endpoints in parallel and returns the unified author, the recent-post list, and computed metrics: average engagement rate, posting cadence (with the window it was measured over), the top post, and the format mix. The profile leg is the only critical leg: if posts can't be fetched the call still returns the profile with post-dependent metrics null, and every leg's status is surfaced in legs[]. Flat 5 credits.

**Query params**

- `handle` (optional, string) - TikTok username or handle, with or without a leading @. One of the identity params is required. · e.g. `mrbeast`
- `user_id` (optional, string) - Numeric TikTok user id. Use it instead of the handle when you already have the stable id, which survives a rename. One of the identity params is required.
- `posts` (optional, integer) - How many recent posts to fetch + average the computed metrics over (1-100, default 25). · e.g. `25`
- `cursor` (optional, string) - Pass a prior response's posts_cursor to deepen the post window.
- `include` (optional, string) - CSV subset of posts,computed (default both). include=computed drops the raw posts[] to save payload.

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `handle`, `user_id`.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/tiktok/profile/full?handle=mrbeast" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```


## GET /v1/tiktok/profile/videos - 1 credit (standard)

List TikTok user videos

**Cost** 1 credit (standard) · **Cache** 600s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** PostList · **Pagination** cursor - `max_cursor`
**Reliability** Multi-source: a primary provider with an automatic fallback. You are charged once no matter how many sources are tried.

Returns a paginated list of recent public videos posted by a TikTok user. Each video includes view count, like count, comment count, share count, caption, and thumbnail URL. ## GET /v1/tiktok/search - 1 credit (standard)

**Cost** 1 credit (standard) · **Cache** 120s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** PostList · **Pagination** cursor - `cursor`

Searches TikTok for videos matching a keyword query. Returns a list of matching videos with view counts, like counts, captions, author info, and thumbnails. Search rows carry no follower count, but every row carries post.ext.author_id (the creator's numeric user id) and post.author.username: pass either to /v1/tiktok/profile (?user_id= or ?handle=) for the creator's current follower count on author.followers at 1 credit, or batch up to 50 usernames per call through POST /v1/prism/profiles at 1 credit per resolved profile. - `region` (optional, string) - Note, this doesn't filter the tiktoks only in a specfic region, it puts the proxy there. Use it in case you want to scrape posts only available for some country. Use 2 letter country codes like US, GB, FR, etc

- `trim` (optional, boolean) - Accepted for compatibility; the response is already the canonical shape, so this flag has no effect.

## GET /v1/tiktok/search/music - 1 credit (standard)

Search TikTok sounds

**Cost** 1 credit (standard) · **Cache** 120s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** PostList · **Pagination** cursor - `cursor`

Searches TikTok's sound catalogue by keyword and returns up to thirty matching sounds per page, each with its title, artist, duration, cover art, a preview audio URL, and the number of videos using it under `post.ext.video_count`. Where TikTok knows the track on the major music stores, `post.ext.dsp_ids` carries its Apple Music, Spotify and Amazon ids, which is what makes a sound joinable to catalogue data outside TikTok. - `filter_by` (optional, enum: all | title | creators) - Which field the keyword is matched against: all (default), title or creators.
- `region` (optional, string) - Two-letter country code for the proxy location. Defaults to US.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/tiktok/search/music?query=espresso" \
```

## GET /v1/tiktok/user/liked - 1 credit (standard)

List the videos a TikTok account has liked

**Cost** 1 credit (standard) · **Cache** 600s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** PostList · **Pagination** cursor - `cursor`

Returns the videos a given TikTok account has liked, newest first, thirty per page. This is the account's own likes feed and it reads in one direction only: it answers what this user liked, not who liked a given video. There is no endpoint for the other direction, on this API or any other, because TikTok keeps the identity of the people who like a post private. Each row is another creator's video and carries that creator's author block, engagement counts and caption. Most accounts keep their likes list private: when they do, the response is `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` and the request is refunded. Check `author.ext` on `/v1/tiktok/profile` first if you want to know before you call. Page with `cursor`, sending back the value from the previous response unchanged.

**Query params**

- `handle` (optional, string) - TikTok username without the @ symbol. · e.g. `chipotle`
- `user_id` (optional, string) - TikTok numeric user ID. Use this for faster responses.
- `cursor` (optional, string) - Cursor from the previous response to fetch the next page of liked videos.

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `handle`, `user_id`.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/tiktok/user/liked?handle=chipotle" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/tiktok/video/screen-text - 5 credits (advanced)

Get TikTok video on-screen text

**Cost** 5 credits (advanced) · **Cache** 600s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** Analytics · **Pagination** none

Extracts the text shown ON the video itself: the overlay captions creators put on screen, which the regular caption and transcript never carry. Two layers are merged: native text-sticker data (present when the creator used TikTok's built-in text tool) and AI OCR of the video's cover frame, which also catches text burned in with editors like CapCut that no data provider returns. `texts` is the deduplicated union in reading order; `native_texts` and `ocr_texts` expose each layer separately and `source` says which layers produced data. A video with no on-screen text returns an empty `texts` array (that is a real answer, not an error). Costs 5 credits; auto-refunds when the video lookup or the whole extraction fails.

**Query params**

- `url` (required) - Full URL of the TikTok video · e.g. `https://www.tiktok.com/@stoolpresidente/video/7499229683859426602`

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/tiktok/video/screen-text?url=https://www.tiktok.com/@stoolpresidente/video/7499229683859426602" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## Withdrawn endpoints (do not call)

These stay registered but return `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` today and never bill. A permanent withdrawal is not coming back - use the alternative named in the platform's other endpoints rather than retrying.

- `GET /v1/tiktok/creators/popular` - withdrawn permanently - the platform discontinued the data source it depends on, so it is not expected to return. Returns `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` and never bills.
- `GET /v1/tiktok/hashtags/popular` - withdrawn permanently - the platform discontinued the data source it depends on, so it is not expected to return. Returns `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` and never bills.
- `GET /v1/tiktok/songs/popular` - withdrawn permanently - the platform discontinued the data source it depends on, so it is not expected to return. Returns `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` and never bills.
- `GET /v1/tiktok/videos/popular` - withdrawn permanently - the platform discontinued the data source it depends on, so it is not expected to return. Returns `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` and never bills.
